ability_hotbar.menu.title: Ability Menu
ability_hotbar.menu.detail_hint: Hover an ability to inspect it.
ability_hotbar.menu.hint: Click a slot to assign · Esc to close
ability_hotbar.configuration.display.too: How and where the ability bar is drawn.
ability_hotbar.configuration.hotbar.tool: Server-side limits on the ability bar.
ability_hotbar.configuration.slotsPerBar: Preferred slots per hotbar bar; lowered to the server's maximum when needed. Default: 9.
ability_hotbar.configuration.hotbarCount: How many built-in hotbars Alt+wheel and Alt+number cycle through; lowered to the server's maximum when needed. Registered hotbars are always included. Default: 3.
ability_hotbar.configuration.skipEmptyBa: Alt+wheel cycling skips hotbars with no assigned abilities. Direct selection (Alt+number) always lands where pressed. Default: on.
ability_hotbar.configuration.switchToast: Show the active hotbar's name briefly above the bar after a switch. Default: on.
ability_hotbar.configuration.menu.toolti: Remembered filters for the ability management menu.
ability_hotbar.configuration.lastTab.too: The menu tab the ability menu had selected when it was last closed (empty = the All tab).
ability_hotbar.configuration.lastSubCate: The subcategory filter the ability menu had selected when it was last closed (empty = no filter). The filter belongs to the tab it was picked on.
ability_hotbar.configuration.description: Description pane lines scrolled per wheel notch. Default: 16.
ability_hotbar.configuration.dragToAssig: Allow dragging an ability row onto a slot cell to assign it. Default: on.
ability_hotbar.configuration.style.toolt: The ability menu's visual style (empty = the built-in style).
ability_hotbar.configuration.barStyles.t: Per-bar hotbar styles chosen in the ability menu (barId=styleId pairs; empty = vanilla default).
true draws a left-to-right row, false a top-to-bottom column. Default: true.
ability_hotbar.configuration.opacity.too: Transparency of the whole bar: 0.0 is invisible, 1.0 is fully opaque. Default: 1.0.
ability_hotbar.configuration.showCooldow: Draw the cooldown progress overlay on slots. Default: true.
ability_hotbar.configuration.offsetX.too: Horizontal pixel offset from the bar's anchor. Default: 0.
ability_hotbar.configuration.offsetY.too: Vertical pixel offset from the bar's anchor. Default: 0.
ability_hotbar.configuration.scale.toolt: Size multiplier for the whole bar; 1.0 is native size. Default: 1.0.
ability_hotbar.configuration.showIcons.t: Draw ability icons in assigned slots; a placeholder is used when none resolves. Default: true.
ability_hotbar.configuration.anchor.tool: Named screen position for the bar; every position works with either orientation. Default: above hotbar.
ability_hotbar.configuration.statusAncho: Height used by Above status bars: Dynamic tracks hearts, armor and oxygen, Fixed uses the vanilla baseline. Default: Dynamic.
ability_hotbar.configuration.maxSlots.to: Highest slot count any bar may have; clients are clamped to this. Default: 10.
ability_hotbar.configuration.maxBars.too: Highest number of built-in hotbars in the Alt+wheel / Alt+number cycle (server ceiling). Mod-registered hotbars are always included and never clipped. Default: 10.
ability_hotbar.configuration.switchToast: Milliseconds the bar's name stays on screen after switching hotbars. Default: 2500.
Pixels above the bar the switch toast sits. Default: 12.
ability_hotbar.configuration.listScrollR: Ability list rows scrolled per mouse-wheel notch. Default: 1.
ability_hotbar.configuration.pauseGame.t: Whether opening the ability menu pauses the game in singleplayer. Default: off.
ability_hotbar.configuration.detailPaneW: Width of the detail pane as a percent of the screen. Default: 33.
ability_hotbar.configuration.selectionAl: Alpha (0-255) of the selected row and slot highlight. Default: 88.
Alpha (0-255) of the hovered row and slot highlight. Default: 55.
ability_hotbar.configuration.dragThresho: Pixels an ability row must move before a press becomes a drag onto a slot. Default: 6.
ability_hotbar.configuration.detailDragP: Pixels of press-dragging in the detail pane per line scrolled. Default: 4.
ability_hotbar.configuration.rowHeight.t: Height of each ability list row in pixels. Default: 36.
ability_hotbar.configuration.slotCellHei: Height of the bottom slot cells in pixels (30 minimum, the three-line cell needs it). Default: 32.
ability_hotbar.configuration.maxPresetNa: Highest number of characters in a saved loadout preset's name; longer names are refused (server ceiling). Default: 32.
